blocks.context: Before you ride, check the purpose, duration, intensity target, recovery, and notes. A green box means very little if you missed the reason for the workout.

blocks.content:
### Read the week first

The work around a hard session changes what that session can do. Easy days leave room for the hard ones. Long rides build durability. Recovery weeks absorb the work you have already done. Before Monday, find the sessions that need your best legs.

### When life changes the plan

Leave the missed workout where it is. Tell me what changed and when you can train next. I will decide whether the workout moves, changes, or disappears.

blocks.title: Before Every Hard Session
blocks.description: This takes about 30 seconds and catches most avoidable mistakes.

steps.detail: Know whether the target is aerobic durability, threshold control, repeatability, technique, or recovery.
Choose a route or trainer setup that lets you execute without turning logistics into extra intensity.
Long or demanding sessions need fuel before the bonk sends you into a gas station looking for miracles.
Leave enough in the tank for the work that follows.

blocks.question: You miss Tuesday's intervals and Wednesday is an easy day. What should you do?

options.text: Comment with what happened and your next available window; wait for Matti to adjust the plan

blocks.explanation: Tell me what happened and when you can train next. Stacking missed work often ruins the sessions that still matter.
